observed: User screenshot Screenshot_2026-11-01_12-16-38.png: property SelectedItem missing when continuing from the network page of installer 1.6.
root_cause: Legacy startup migration assigns a model ID to unqualified script-level $default. PowerShell is case-insensitive, so this overwrites the ComboBox stored in $script:Default. Build-Config then fails at Default.SelectedItem.
fix: Rename the migration data variable to previousDefaultModelId; preserve the default selection control.
important_limit: Actual startup statements run with simulated controls at script scope in portable PowerShell. The complete Windows Forms GUI was not executed.
